_about: Path to 50,000 Google clicks a month by July 2027. Analysis only, Oct 16, 2026. Sources: Search Console (owner API pull to Oct 12 in the session scratchpad growth/gsc_growth.json; Ahrefs-connected GSC history to Sep 11), Ahrefs API v3 (30,134 units, Oct 16), stored files under data/. Ahrefs traffic figures are estimates; Search Console figures are measurements.

api_units_used.note: Workspace counter read 99,941 of 200,000 before this run; another agent ran in parallel, so the workspace total is not this run alone.

our_site_ahrefs.ahrefs_project: BuzzSkito project 9659460 is verified and GSC-connected, but the connection stopped syncing on Sep 11, 2026 and the per-page and per-query GSC tables are empty; only the daily totals history is available through Ahrefs.

site_traffic.method: Ahrefs weekly organic-traffic estimate vs Search Console clicks, same months
site_traffic.read: Ahrefs site-level traffic estimates are close to reality for this site (x1.1, lagging about a month). Apply x1.1 (0.8-1.4) to competitor estimates.

keyword_volume.method: 40 US queries where Ahrefs shows the site at positions 4-20: Ahrefs US volume vs Search Console US impressions per month for the same query
keyword_volume.read: For an exact query where the site is on page 1, Search Console records about a quarter of the searches Ahrefs reports, before any click-through. This is consistent with next-50.md (20-40x when a whole topic is compared).

ctr_by_position_site.method: impression-weighted, queries with 200+ impressions (all countries) / 100+ (US), 90 days to Oct 12
ctr_by_position_site.note: Several head terms show positions 1-3 that are AI Overview citations with near-zero clicks (bed bugs 0.6%, mosquito 0.3%, horse fly 0%); true organic top-3 pages earn 6-19% (photon matrix review 19%, worst areas for ticks in ontario 9%).

striking_distance_totals.note: page x query rows are pruned by Search Console; use for ranking pages, not totals. Gains assume every listed query reaches the top 3, which is the ceiling, not the forecast.

plan_july_2027.unit: Google clicks in July 2027 (Search Console definition), low / middle / high

steps.note: taken as given; its own uncertainty is not added here

steps.what: Push the 60 existing pages with the most position 4-20 impressions into the top 3
steps.method: top-60 ceiling 4,630 / 8,631 / 13,962 (CTR 2.5/4/6% at top 3) x success rate 30/40/50%

steps.what: Click-through upgrades on existing pages (photo-ID titles and photos, same positions)
steps.method: site CTR +0.1 / +0.2 / +0.33 points on ~1.5M July impressions; may overlap with step 2; read the Oct 15-16 upgrades on Oct 29-30 first

steps.what: 500 new US pages beyond the plan, Nov 1 - Mar 15, only on topics where a DR<=30 page already ranks top 5
steps.method: 500 pages x 12 / 25 / 60 clicks per page in July (site median new page 12; July-2026 cohort mean 40 in season; comparable blogs 70-130 per page, Ahrefs x1.1)

steps.what: Links: 150-250 dofollow referring domains from real sites (DR 20+) by April
steps.note: not added separately: it is what moves step 4 from the middle to the high yield and steps 2-3 toward their high values

steps.what: US editions of the ~12 Canadian informational pages with US impressions and no US edition

plan_july_2027.verdict: 50K by July 2027 is reachable only in the high case (new US pages performing like the small pest-company blogs that already do it, which needs both volume and links). The realistic middle is about 36K. The single biggest lever is the number of US identification pages that reach Google top 3.

timing.build_rate: 25-35 extra pages a week Nov-Mar on top of the scheduled releases (~20 weeks)
